Originally from Chiayi, Taiwan, Anne Shih immigrated to the U.S. in 1978 with two children.
She started volunteer service at the Bower Museum in 1992. She joined the museum board in 1996
and created the Junior Ambassador program introducing high school students to art and culture.

facts: After serving one year as the vice-president of the Taiwanese American
Historical Society, I was elected to as President of the Society in 2014. The
term was supposed be 3 years. Due to the physical condition of the founding
president Charles Yang, he handed the big job to me. Thanks to God, in one
year he fully recovered from two surgeries and helped me with the Society.
people.notes: 會長謝詞; president after founding president Charles Yang (楊嘉猷)
